Graduate Teaching Assistantships
Regular Graduate Teaching Assistantships (GTA) provide the following compensation:
A stipend of $26,550 for master’s students and $27,810 for PhD students (effective August 16, 2026) for a 9-month teaching assistantship.
Full tuition for up to 15 hours in each of the fall and spring semesters.
Single coverage health insurance (provided by the UA Graduate School).
Payment of college and departmental fees (averaging $600/semester).
GTA duties may consist of teaching, tutoring, grading, conducting problem sessions for courses taught in large lecture sections, or other duties as needed.

Summer Support
The department usually provides summer supports in the forms of scholarships, summer teaching, or research assistantships.
Departmental Scholarships
Edith & Richard Ainsworth Endowed Scholarship: Priority of consideration is given to graduate students studying applied mathematics.
Hasell Palmer Endowed Scholarship: Awarded to students pursuing a graduate degree in mathematics. The scholarship is renewable.
Henry C. Miller Jr. Endowed Scholarship: Priority for the award given to highly talented doctoral candidates in mathematics.
Departmental Awards
The departments has the following awards for graduate students:
Outstanding research by a PhD student
Outstanding research by a master’s student
Outstanding teaching by a PhD student
Outstanding teaching by a master’s student
Outstanding service by a PhD student
Outstanding service by a master’s student
